summary: Recovered the stale metrics-audit lane and derived a denominator-safe runtime baseline. Global useful-results-per-human-intervention, automatic-work ratio and stale rate remain UNKNOWN/PARTIAL where canonical denominators are incomplete. Return-artifact coverage at the pinned snapshot is control-plan 7/7, alumnos-teacher 7/7, facultad-digital 4/7 and prometeo-mobile 3/7, explicitly not terminal throughput. A route-changing concurrency falsification was found: two Kernel recovery claims 29 seconds apart both recorded no active overlap, proving read-then-write overlap preflight cannot guarantee exclusive recovery ownership under concurrency.
route_changing_findings: Metrics must join semantic lifecycle events; path existence alone cannot represent terminal/integrated progress.
Recovery ownership needs an atomic durable fence/create-if-absent primitive or equivalent; preflight overlap checks alone are raceable.
